definitions.valid_event: Row of activity_events that (1) is the first-ingested delivery of its client_event_id, (2) references an existing enrollment, and (3) has event_time_utc within [enrolled_at, cohort access_end_date + 1 day).
definitions.learner_local_date: UTC date of (event_time_utc + learners.utc_offset_minutes); the learner master offset is used (not the device offset, which can be missing).
definitions.week: ISO week, Monday start, of the learner-local date. Weeks are labelled by their Monday.
definitions.active_learner_week: Learner with >= 1 valid event in the week.
definitions.engaged_learner_week: Learner with >= 5 valid events in the week.
definitions.events_per_active_learner: valid events / active learners in the week.
definitions.late_event_share: Share of the week's valid events ingested after the week had ended (restatement risk for a report published at week end).
definitions.cohort_week_k_active_rate: Enrollments of a cohort with >= 1 valid event in cohort week k (k = 0..3, week k = days [7k, 7k+6] after the cohort start date, learner-local) / enrollments of the cohort. Only cohorts whose whole window ended before the data cut-off are compared, so every cohort is measured over exactly the same number of weeks.
definitions.completion_rate: course_outcomes.outcome_status = completed / enrollments, for cohorts whose access window (end_date + completion_window_days) closed before the cut-off. Open cohorts are right-censored and excluded.
definitions.median_days_to_complete: median of (rule_met_at_utc - enrolled_at) in days over completed enrollments.
definitions.cohort_comparison: Cohorts are only compared within the same duration_weeks and start month, i.e. over identical windows.
